app-leftovers.caches.name: Caches of removed apps
app-leftovers.caches.line: Caches of apps you have removed
app-leftovers.caches.what: Caches, logs and saved windows of apps that are no longer on this Mac.
app-leftovers.caches.made-by: The apps, while they were installed; each item names its app, such as com.example.App.
app-leftovers.caches.if-removed: They go to the Trash, and nothing you made is in them.
app-leftovers.caches.comes-back: Only if you install the app again.
app-leftovers.settings.name: Settings of removed apps
app-leftovers.settings.line: Settings of apps you have removed
app-leftovers.settings.what: The settings, cookies and website data of apps that are no longer on this Mac.
app-leftovers.settings.made-by: The apps, while they were installed; each item names its app, such as com.example.App.
app-leftovers.settings.if-removed: If you install the app again, it starts with its default settings and you may need to sign in again.
app-leftovers.data.name: Data of removed apps
app-leftovers.data.line: Data of apps you have removed
app-leftovers.data.what: What apps no longer on this Mac kept for you, such as documents, databases or downloads.
app-leftovers.data.made-by: The apps, while they were installed; each item names its app, such as com.example.App.
app-leftovers.data.if-removed: Anything the app kept only here is lost once you empty the Trash, so look inside first.
app-leftovers.enabled.label: Leftovers of removed apps
app-leftovers.enabled.description: Finds the files that apps you removed left behind: caches, settings and data, matched by the app's id.
app-leftovers.uninstalled-after-days.lab: Offer a removed app's files after
app-leftovers.uninstalled-after-days.des: The files of an app that is no longer installed are offered only once none of them has changed for this many days, at least 7.
app-leftovers.choice.everything.label: Remove everything
app-leftovers.choice.everything.descript: Removes all files the removed apps left behind. If you install one of them again, it starts fresh.
app-leftovers.choice.keep-settings.label: Keep settings
app-leftovers.choice.keep-settings.descr: Removes only caches and logs. Your settings and data stay, in case you install an app again.
app-leftovers.finding.reason: No app with this id is installed on this Mac, and none of its files has changed in the last {days} days. If this app is on a drive that is not connected now, keep these.
app-leftovers.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your apps, so it cannot tell whether this app is gone. It keeps these files. Scan again.
app-leftovers.left-out.apps-unread: Fresher could not read every app in your apps folders, so it cannot be sure this app is gone. It keeps these files.
app-leftovers.left-out.running: This app is open, though it is not in your apps folders. Its files are kept.
app-leftovers.left-out.scan-again: Fresher could not look at every place this app may keep files in, so it keeps these. Scan again to check.
app-leftovers.left-out.used-recently: These files changed within the days set in Settings, so the app may have been removed only lately. A scan after those days offers them.
app-leftovers.left-out.spotlight-unread: Fresher could not search every drive with Spotlight, so this app may be installed elsewhere and its files are kept. Turn Spotlight on, then scan again.
app-leftovers.left-out.installed-elsewhe: An app with this id is on this Mac outside your apps folders, so its files are kept.
app-leftovers.left-out.special: A running program may be using it, so it is kept.
app-leftovers.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to macOS or another user, or is locked, so only an administrator can remove it.
